name: Amazon Vendor Central
shortInfo: Manage items, orders, prices, promotions, inventory, and reports on Amazon.
brief: Amazon Vendor Central provides resources for manufacturers and distributors also known as first-party seller to manage items, orders, prices, promotions, inventory and reports on Amazon. DataChannel’s Amazon Vendor Central Connector enables streaming relevant marketplace data into a user determined warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
about:
Advertising solutions for vendors. Promote your brand and products to millions of Amazon customers you want to reach shoppers, drive sales, and continually grow your audience. Sponsored ads help you meet these goals at scale, no matter what your experience level or budget.  
Learn more about [Amazon Vendor Central API documentation](https://advertising.amazon.com/library/guides/vendors).
availableData:
[Vendor Sales Report by Date](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-vendor-central/pipelines/vendor-sales-report-by-date.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve key retail sales metrics such as ordered/shipped revenue and units, grouped at the date level.

[Vendor Sales Report by ASIN](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-vendor-central/pipelines/vendor-sales-report-by-asin.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve key retail sales metrics such as ordered/shipped revenue and units, grouped at the ASIN level.

[Net Pure Product Margin Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-vendor-central/pipelines/net-pure-product-margin-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data on Amazon’s net pure product margins for selling a vendor’s items, grouped at the date level.

[Net Pure Product Margin Report by ASIN](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-vendor-central/pipelines/net-pure-product-margin-report-by-asin.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all the data on Amazon’s net pure product margins for selling a vendor’s items, grouped at the ASIN level.

[Vendor Traffic Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-vendor-central/pipelines/vendor-traffic-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve key retail traffic metrics such as detail page views (i.e. glance views), grouped at the date level.

[Vendor Traffic Report by ASIN](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-vendor-central/pipelines/vendor-traffic-report-by-asin.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve key retail traffic metrics such as detail page views (i.e. glance views), grouped at the ASIN level.  
  
Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/amazon-vendor-central/index.html) here.
